name: Unfaithful
overview: Scripture clearly condemns unfaithfulness, emphasizing that adultery is a serious sin that defiles both the heart and marriage. The commandment 'Thou shalt not commit adultery' (Exodus 20:14) is expanded by Christ to include lustful intent as equivalent to adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28). The teachings also warn against divorce except for the cause of fornication, as remarriage under other circumstances constitutes adultery (Matthew 5:32; 19:9). Proverbs highlights the destructive nature of adultery on the soul, and Hebrews affirms that God will judge adulterers, underscoring the holiness and honor due to marriage (Proverbs 6:32; Hebrews 13:4).
